about.message: Post-Processing extension to trigger SickChill after downloads.
about.description: Short description of the Notify SickChill extension shown in settings.

requirements.message: This extension is compatible to Python 3.8 and above.
requirements.description: System requirements (each requirement is a separate string). DO NOT translate technical version strings (e.g., Python 3.8.x).

host_desc.description: Help text for the host option in Notify SickChill.

port_desc.description: Help text for the port option in Notify SickChill.

apikey_desc.message:
Used to authenticate and authorize access to the SickChill API.

Can be found in the settings of the web interface of SickChill.
apikey_desc.description: Help text for the apiKey option in Notify SickChill.

processmethod_desc.description: Help text for the processMethod option in Notify SickChill.

forcereplace_desc.message: Force already post-processed files to be post-processed again.
forcereplace_desc.description: Help text for the forceReplace option in Notify SickChill.

ispriority_desc.message:
Mark Dir/Files as priority download.

Replaces the file even if it exists at higher quality.
ispriority_desc.description: Help text for the isPriority option in Notify SickChill.

delete_desc.message:
Delete files and folders after completion of Post-Processing.

Recommended when Process Method is Copy, Hard link or Symbolic link:
original files remain in the download directory and are removed after processing.
With Move it cleans up leftover files and empty folders.
delete_desc.description: Help text for the delete option in Notify SickChill.

verbose_desc.message:
Print more logging messages.

For debugging.
verbose_desc.description: Help text for the Verbose option in Notify SickChill.

ping_desc.message: Ping SickChill to check if it is running.
ping_desc.description: Help text for the ping option in Notify SickChill.
